evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Clinical, detached framing of a production failure — reproducing a problem without affective charge, registering as low-arousal negative.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Imperative directives with 'must' carry urgency-as-demand — high arousal, negative valence oriented toward preventing failure.
